architecture: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration (text_config; MoE block enabled; vision tower and embedding_projection out of scope by contract)
revision_note: HF repo commit pinned by the independent anchor kit (batch-gemma4-val ANCHORS.md); warm config.json and model.safetensors.index.json are byte-identical to the publisher snapshots at that commit

scope.vision_tower: model.vision_tower.* + model.embed_vision.embedding_projection.weight out of scope by contract
scope.decode_only_v1: prefill fails closed in the v1 module; boundaries per DESIGN section 7

sources.verification: HF LFS sha256 oid equality at the pinned revision plus byte-exact size equality on warm; config.json and model.safetensors.index.json sha256 computed twice (workstation + sparka); full shard sha256 confirmation on sparka

model.embed_scale_note: bf16(sqrt(2816)); fp32 buffer cast to bf16 at multiply, the rounding is load-bearing
model.softcap_note: inert for v1: logits-only, monotone under greedy argmax
model.eos_note: generation_config.json eos_token_id; the header binds all three
model.layer_types: 5 sliding_attention : 1 full_attention, full at index 5 mod 6 (config layer_types, 30 entries)

moe.parallel_note: experts.* AND mlp.* present in all 30 layers; ffn = dense branch + MoE branch

router.scale_tensor: router.scale x H**-0.5 applied before proj
router.softmax: fp32 over 128 logits, no epsilon anywhere (uniform 1/128 on a zero residual is the pinned degenerate case)
router.selection: top-8 descending, ties -> lowest index (torch.topk CPU semantics, pinned by the zero-input anchor)
router.accumulation: expert-index order with bf16 adds (pinned by the anchor engine)

sliding.type: default rope, theta 10000, whole-head rotation (128 pairs of 256 dims)

full.type: proportional rope, base 1e6, partial_rotary_factor 0.25 -> 64 rotated pairs, inv_freq[i] = 1e6**(-i/256) for i < 64 then 0
full.k_eq_v: no v_proj tensor; v = scale-free per-head RMS of the raw k projection, taken before k_norm/rope

attention.scaling: qk_scale exactly 1.0; softcap none in attention
attention.norms: q_norm/k_norm per-head with weight; v_norm per-head without weight
attention.extra_norms: 26B carries pre_feedforward_2, post_feedforward_1, post_feedforward_2 (7 per-layer norms vs 4 on 31B)

topology.stage_note: stages of 8/8/7/7 layers; stage boundaries are explicit data; experts 32 per rank, uniform ~3.2GB
topology.tp16_alternative: TP16 table ready (sliding kv 8 x2 / full kv 2 x8 replication); one-table switch, the module is topology-agnostic
topology.kv_replication: TP4: sliding kv 8/8 exact per rank, full kv 2 global heads replicated x2, rank r reads head r/2

pack_folds.router_scale_fold: router.scale folded into router proj at pack time
pack_folds.per_expert_scale_fold: per_expert_scale folded into expert down rows at pack time
pack_folds.sliding_kv_row_fusion: k|v rows fused per DESIGN section 6
pack_folds.full_kv_replication: rank r -> global head r/(tp/kv) at pack time
pack_folds.layer_scalar: assert all-ones fail-closed at pack time

lane_pack_policy.weights: bf16 (experts bf16 grouped; .experts v2 manifest 48B records with spine/expert byte split when the MoE arm packer runs)
lane_pack_policy.nvfp4_seam: payload size math only in v1; never quantize

digest_freeze.policy: small files hashed on workstation and sparka (agreement); shard sha256 = HF LFS oid at the pinned revision with byte-exact warm size equality, local sparka hash confirmation recorded in the lane report

tensor_census.v_proj_note: x25: the 5 full layers carry no v_proj (attention_k_eq_v); sliding layers are 25
tensor_census.no_lm_head: tied embeddings; no router.norm.weight tensor (scale-free); PLE dead

qualification.status: driver aligned to the 50bd0d3 platform; oracle + validator consuming the anchor fixtures; bring-up pending
